title: Claudette: Make Claude stop talking like a BuzzFeed article
summary: This project addresses the common issue of AI models like Claude producing overly enthusiastic, listicle-style responses. It provides a tool or prompt-engineering approach to make Claude's output more neutral and professional, reducing 'BuzzFeed-like' language. The GitHub repo includes a README with implementation details, and the Hacker News discussion highlights community interest in controlling AI tone.
